name: diagnose
title_zh: 先复现再动手的六步排障循环
tagline_zh: 遇到难缠 bug 或性能回退，别急着猜。它逼你先复现、再最小化、再假设，每一步都有据可查，最后补回归测试。
tagline_en: For stubborn bugs or perf regressions, stop guessing. It forces reproduce → minimize → hypothesize → instrument →.
desc_en: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test. Use when user says "diagnose this" / "debug this", reports a bug, says something is broken/throwing/failing, or describes a performance regression.
why_zh: 多数调试是瞎试，它用纪律把排查变成可追溯的流程：先缩小范围再动代码，避免改错地方。
why_en: Most debugging is random poking. This enforces a disciplined, auditable pipeline that narrows scope before touching code, so you.
limit_zh: 只认「诊断/调试/坏了/抛错/性能回退」这类明确信号，不主动找活；需要你配合提供复现步骤，否则流程卡在第一步。
limit_en: Only triggers on explicit debug/broken/perf signals; needs your repro steps or it stalls; outputs fix advice & tests, not direct code edits.
title_en: Six-step disciplined debugging loop: reproduce first, then.
